title: Es igual pero no es lo mismo: ¿Distinguen los LLMs las variedades del español?

bias_targets.methodology: A 30-question multiple-choice test evaluating the models' ability to identify and distinguish morphosyntactic and lexical peculiarities across seven regional varieties of Spanish. Models are evaluated using persona-based prompts (acting as a speaker from a specific region), and their selections are determined using log-probability estimations.
